text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Phew... Hmm, I've still got a ways to go.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It'll take a lot to win against Tamtam and
Oguri.
They're still miles ahead of me in
terms of skill.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
choice_data_list: 焦らずに詰めていこう
焦らずに詰めていこうよ

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
After all, we've taken everything one
step at a
time up until now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
They may seem out of reach today, but
I'm sure
I'll catch up to them
eventually. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So... What should our first goal for next
year be?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If possible, I'd like to go somewhere new

together.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai! At the Hanshin
racecourse, right?
That sounds so
exciting!
choice_data_list: じゃあ『大阪杯』にしようか

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
This year was a tough one, but I hope
next year
starts on a positive note!
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
S'up, Oguri? Is Creek really buggin' ya
that much?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm not worried yet. But if she keeps
improving
like that, then she'll be more
fearsome than
anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
She approaches every race calmly,
resolutely, and
without ever folding.
That's the kind of
Umamusume she is.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The heck? You suddenly got all serious
on me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we have to stay sharp and train
hard.
Also...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna eat till I drop in Osaka.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I should've known you'd be thinkin'
about
somethin' like that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As things heat up, Super Creek realizes
that she
still has a long road ahead of
her.
